harness.name: Harness Software Factory
harness.description: Control tower multi-app factory environment. Source of truth for apps, policies, and development scripts.

unified_source.intent: Use this manifest to adapt the 'asf' harness to run alongside Opencode while keeping a single folder.

commands: /factory-build <app> "spec..." → Writes spec, implements, runs checks, opens PR.
/factory-merge <app> <pr> → auto-merge.py: Fuse low-risk PRs with CI green.
pipeline.pi_adapter_note: When running in Pi, adapt slash-commands to Pi capabilities using 'scripts/' helpers directly. e.g. 'Run the harness health check for mi-mesa' -> executes 'scripts/health.sh mi-mesa staging'.

rules: Never execute destructive actions or payments without asking.
Merge via 'auto-merge.py' is safe by default (shadow mode).
Production deploy requires explicit human order.
